sourceRecords.title: Exact Australian 5000020 dimensions and operating limits
sourceRecords.supports: Black Max 21m, eight long rails; open H155 W70 D90cm, closed H76 W66 D10cm, 6.9kg, 15kg maximum evenly distributed load. Indoor only, flat surface, pinch-point and child-play precautions. Amazon summary dimensions 10D x70W x76H and 8.1kg are not used as the open footprint or product mass; manufacturer centimetres control. AU page inch conversion for height is inconsistent, so inches omitted. No faster-drying or comparative durability claim.

sourceRecords.title: Exact-size owner feedback separated from pooled variants
sourceRecords.supports: Australian 21m owners S L Nance (28 August 2026) and Sarah (30 September 2026) describe useful capacity/folding; Sarah notes larger-than-expected size. Five overseas 21m accounts support solid feel and folding but are not local long-term tests. The 2 October side-joint failure is explicitly 16m and is retained as range context, not misreported as a Max failure. No failure rate, star-based recommendation or superiority claim.

sourceRecords.title: Individual manufacturer-hosted comments
sourceRecords.supports: Individual comments on the Max page mention weight, cost and learning the opening mechanism. These may be pooled and selected by the brand, so are supporting context only; AI-generated summary and durability predictions not adopted. Exact-model retailer feedback separately inspected.

sourceRecords.title: New offer, returns and Australian claim route
sourceRecords.supports: Primary Buy New panel names Amazon AU as both seller and dispatcher. Conditional original-condition change-of-mind returns within 30 days; listing also states damaged/defective items may have remedies after that period. This is not a 30-day durability warranty. Start order/fault support through Amazon AU. No foreign seller, marketplace or resale offer approved by this assessment; seller choice can change.

sourceRecords.title: Australian retail warranty scope and support
sourceRecords.supports: Current AU FAQ: authorised-retailer purchases have one year against manufacturing defects, unless otherwise stated; direct-site purchases have two years. Claims require proof of purchase and product/batch details. Guarantee excludes wear, misuse, unauthorised repairs and pre-owned/refurbished/unauthorised resale. Australian support contact info.au@josephjoseph.com. Exact Amazon AU seller support independently verified. No special AirFrame extension or blanket two-year Amazon guarantee claimed.

sourceRecords.title: Dated Australian recall search and access limitation
sourceRecords.supports: 27 October indexed searches restricted to productsafety.gov.au for Joseph Joseph and AirFrame found no matching recall. Direct filtered RSS returned HTTP403 and was not bypassed; no claim of exhaustive live database clearance. Manufacturer care warnings reviewed. No matching Australian recall or specific Max mechanical defect advisory found; absence of a search result is not safety certification.

sourceRecords.title: Regional chemical disclosure considered
sourceRecords.supports: US disclosure lists SKU5000020 under a California Proposition65 1,3-butadiene warning. OEHHA FAQ says a warning does not itself establish violation of safety standards. No product-specific exposure assessment or Australian recall was found; neither toxicity-free nor health-risk claims are made. Australian care instructions control use; regional disclosure is retained rather than erased.
